correctness.rationale: C PASS: Reyes Theorem C puts all invariant measures and hence all periodic points of Sigma(k/(k+1)) inside the coded subshift generated by words 0^g1^{kg}, g>=1. For any nonconstant periodic word, its complete alternating runs are these generator pairs, and occurrences of 10 uniquely encode generator junctions, all at one residue modulo L=k+1. Thus L|n is necessary. For n=Lm, a residue r and a nonempty subset of m macro positions correspond bijectively to one nonconstant n-fixed word, including those of smaller least period. Therefore F_n=2 off multiples, and 2+L(2^m-1) on multiples; the formal log of the Artin–Mazur zeta evaluates exactly to (1-z^L)/[(1-z)^2(1-2z^L)]. The iid Bernoulli(1/2) macro markers with uniform phase form a stationary shift measure with entropy log2/L, hence Reyes's unique MME. Coupling the m-cycle's uniform nonempty marker set with two-sided iid markers on a local window, and separately bounding absent bracketing markers, gives O(2^{-m/4}) cylinder convergence for divisible periods. Nondivisible n have exactly the two constant points. The exact [01] cylinder statistic 2^{m-1}/[2+L(2^m-1)] separates MME from atomic mixture eta and rules out third accumulation limits. Independent direct cyclic-run enumeration for k=1..3 and n=1..12 matches the fixed census and marker counts. Finite checks are not used to justify all-n or weak-star conclusions.
